arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Todd Kim argued the lower courts made two fundamental errors in analyzing probable cause.
Todd Kim stated the lower courts took important facts out of context.
Todd Kim claimed the lower courts used an inappropriate divide-and-conquer analysis.
Todd Kim emphasized that probable cause is a practical standard for officers.
